literal: Those who secure the supportive companions who reprove, who indeed are they with the capability of ruining them?
translation: Who indeed has the power to ruin those who secure the guidance of companions who have the courage to reprove them when they err?
modern: தவறு செய்யும்போது கடிந்து அறிவுரை கூறும் பெரியோர்களைத் துணையாகக் கொண்டு வாழ்பவர்களை அழிக்கும் ஆற்றல் உடையவர் யார் இருக்கிறார்கள்?
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme protection gained by keeping wise and honest companions. The word 'இடிக்கும்' means to sharply reprove or admonish, describing friends who do not hesitate to point out one's faults. Those who 'secure' (ஆள்வரை) such companions are shielded from moral and political downfall. The rhetorical question asks who could possibly have the power to ruin such a person, emphasizing that sincere, critical guidance makes one invincible.
